wolfram.note: Ours holds the series at infinity unevaluated; Wolfram expands it as E^x plus a power series in 1/x, over x^(5/2).
ours leaves the exact value 1F1Regularized(1/2, 1, 1/2) unevaluated; Wolfram writes it as E^(1/4) BesselI(0, 1/4). Nothing reduces a regularized hypergeometric to Bessel I at exact arguments.
